hypothesis.statement: A matte can be adequate for coarse shape recovery while remaining inadequate for accessory or production detail; a single boolean approval would erase that distinction.
hypothesis.action: Bind approval to canonical index, derivative checksum, matte lineage, narrow purpose, mandatory exclusions, named reviewer role and a maximum 30-day validity window, then require it in the runner.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Temporary face/body shape reconstruction can be authorized without approving hair strands, earrings, fingers, shoelaces, garment topology, skin or final topology.

failureHandling: reject scope expansion or missing exclusions
reject future, expired or overlong approval windows
reject derivative or matte checksum changes
reject approval lineage that differs from runner input
decision: Keep both requests unsigned. The character owner or art director must explicitly accept the narrow shape-only scope before either draft reaches a reconstruction backend.
